name: PM SVANidhi
full_name: Pradhan Mantri Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi
benefit: Collateral-free working capital loan — ₹10,000 (1st), ₹20,000 (2nd), ₹50,000 (3rd), plus 7% interest subsidy and cashback on digital transactions
benefit_hindi: Bina guarantee ke loan — pehla ₹10,000, doosra ₹20,000, teesra ₹50,000, 7% byaaj chhoot

eligibility.description: Street vendors with Certificate of Vending or Letter of Recommendation from ULB
eligibility.description_hindi: Street vendor jiske paas vending certificate ya nagar nigam ki chitthi ho
criteria: Street vendor with vending certificate or recommendation
Identified in ULB survey or has vending certificate
Must repay previous loan to get next tier
exclusions: Vendors not identified by Urban Local Body

documents_required: Vending Certificate or Letter of Recommendation from ULB

steps: Repay in 12 monthly installments, earn cashback on digital payments
steps_hindi: 12 mahine mein vapas karein, digital payment par cashback milega

hindi_summary: PM SVANidhi mein street vendor ko bina guarantee ke 10000 rupaye ka loan milta hai. Samay par vapas karne par 20000 aur phir 50000 tak ka loan milta hai. Online apply karein ya nagar nigam se sampark karein.
